idea: How to prevent bathroom pipe problems
title: 4 Simple Ways to Avoid Bathroom Pipe Clogs
description: Preventable clogs and hidden leaks cause most bathroom plumbing emergencies. To keep your pipes flowing smoothly, never flush wipes, paper towels, or personal hygiene products, even if the packaging claims they are flushable. Use mesh drain strainers in shower and sink drains to catch hair and soap scum before they build up inside the P-trap. Periodically check underneath your bathroom vanity for minor drips at the trap slip joints and inspect braided supply lines for rust or bulging. Catching small issues early protects your home from costly water damage. If drainage stays slow, contact a licensed professional plumber.
